description: This file defines the PartialEmployeeAttachment class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing a partial view of an employee attachment, including metadata such as attachment ID, description, filename, size, file type, attached by information, and timestamps.

classes.name: PartialEmployeeAttachment
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for partial employee attachment details, including file metadata and attachment timestamps. Uses traits for date-time formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize attachment properties, setting date and time strings via helper methods.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedByName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the attached time as a formatted string.

methods.name: setAttachedTime
methods.description: Sets the attached time string from a DateTime object using helper.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the attached date as a formatted string.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the attached date string from a DateTime object using helper.
